note: SC1002 reach: an async helper called through untrack keeps its reads outside the window, so its read after the await is a violation (UntrackedAsyncHelper); runWithOwner(null, fn) runs with no owner, so a read in it is a violation, and with an owner the analysis cannot see through it is uncertifiable (the runtime is silent for a live owner); a read after `for await` is uncertifiable. The *Control components keep the window or the owner
